invariants: every call: front end (features, chain, segment_id, guard_reason) bit-exact vs the stored S4-REAL-02 decode
option off (regression): features, chain, segment_id, guard_reason, line_id, status, n_candidates, accepted, points (NaN positions) bit-exact; evaluation metrics equal
option abstain, raster without lit clipped band (H1-H3): every array bit-exact vs stored (no-op)
option abstain: complete-line candidate columns (Q, Q_design, z, mu, admissible) of the extended family bit-exact vs the plain family on the same features
option abstain: number of admissible complete-line candidates per feature == stored n_candidates
option abstain: no accepted feature carries a clipped id; status counts (incl. 11 abstain) sum to the detected features
gate 5: minimal-input run (copied spec / pattern only) of the audit counter-example == the main run, array by array
